messages:
Aisha (infra): FYI scheduling a soft-reboot maintenance for the 'auster' GPU cohort in us-west2 on Mon 03:00-05:00 UTC. Reason: NIC microcode update + BIOS thermal trim to reduce intermittent tx drops. No PSU cycles planned.
Brett (sre): Got it. Rough capacity impact?
Aisha (infra): Expect ~9% peak capacity reduction. We'll drain then soft-restart nodes one-by-one with parallelism=2 and cadence ~1 node / 75s. Warm spares will be used.
Cam (oncall): 9% is okay if warmbackfill is ready. Do we have seeded prefix/KV cache on the spares?
Rina (scheduler): Yes  reserving 6 warm GPUs in the same AZ: pool auster-warm. Seeding command: `ops/seed --pool=auster-warm --keys=top100 --workers=4`. Seeding starts 90m before window.
Harper (support): I'll draft a status blurb for pinned capacity customers. Draft: "Planned maintenance in us-west2 may cause transient latency and minor capacity throttling 03:00-05:00 UTC. No data loss expected. Contact support if you have pinned reservations."
Brett (sre): Canary plan: 1 canary node, 5% traffic for 10m, health gates: p95 < baseline+35ms, error-rate < 0.6%. If canary fails auto-stop and rollback to previous NIC image.
Rina (scheduler): Canary encoded in jobs/auster/restart-roll.yaml (canary:1, canary_traffic:0.05, max_parallel:2).
Aisha (infra): Routing hint: avoid nodes with uptime <4m (`route_avoid_recent_boot=true`). Also will temporarily steer latency-sensitive customers away.
Cam (oncall): Paging rule: if free GPUs in region <4 for >5m, page oncall. Also alert on KV-miss > 9% for 2 consecutive 1m windows.
Brett (sre): Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auster-softcycle. Steps: pause rollout -> rollback_firmware -> rehydrate caches. If canary p95 regresses >30ms run tcpdump `tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/auster-canary.pcap`.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: "auster maintenance in 24h" posting to #eng-infra and #oncall.
Harper (support): I'll post draft to #customer-success-drafts and notify dedicated tenants. Include note about temporary cross-region fallback to eu-west if needed.
Aisha (infra): Cost note: warmbackfill estimate ~$1.2k for the window (GPU hours + IO). Finance approved.
Rina (scheduler): Timeline: 01:30 seed caches, 02:50 smoke test, 03:00 canary reboot, 03:12 evaluate, 03:15 start rolling (parallel=2), finish ~04:45, 05:00 cool-down.
Cam (oncall): I'll be standby 02:45-05:15. Brett will own rollback gates?
Brett (sre): Yep, I'll own gates and health dashboard.
Aisha (infra): Please react :thumbsup: to acknowledge. I'll set infra-bot reminders at 2h and 15m.
Rina (scheduler): :thumbsup:
Harper (support): :thumbsup:
Cam (oncall): :thumbsup: will join if canary trips.
Brett (sre): :thumbsup: prepping dashboards now.
infra-bot: Deploy job queued: `auster-soft-restart-v3` at 6141592653 (dry-run OK).
Aisha (infra): Thanks team. I'll post final customer message after legal/product review. Anything else?
Cam (oncall): Nothing further. :coffee:
